title: 3.4.3.2 crashes at Tidepool login when no OAUTH browser is installed.
body:
### Summary:  
AAPS 3.4.2.3 crashes on LineageOS 20 (Android 13) on a Motorola Moto X4 (payton) immediately after startup if Tidepool is enabled, and Crome is not installed.

### Reason:
Logcat shows a FATAL EXCEPTION caused by ActivityNotFoundException inside the Tidepool OAuth flow, since AuthorizationService attempts to launch a browser intent, but no browser app is installed:

```
android.content.ActivityNotFoundException at net.openid.appauth.AuthorizationService.prepareAuthorizationRequestIntent
```

### Fix:  
Installing a suitable browser (tried Chrome) resolves the crash.
Pre-3.4 AAPS versions did not crash in this situation.

###  
It should be sufficcient to include a warning in the update notes. Considering that most users problably have Chrome pre-installed, those that are affected are most likely experienced enough to handle the resulting problems from their customized Android installation ;)

Preferably though, AAPS could check for a valid browser before initiating Tidepool OAuth and fail gracefully.
